summary: Scalar 2x2 box-average image compositor. Processes a4 output rows; for each output pixel it averages a 2x2 source neighborhood (left pixel, current pixel, and the two pixels one source row below via stride a5) using channel-separated byte math with rounding constant 131074 and carry base 0x00800080, writing one dword to the destination cursor a1. Source advances 2*dword per output dword and two source rows per output row, so the pass is a 2:1 box downsample. The MMX wrapper 0x00503772 dispatches here as its misalignment fallback.

operations.description: Empty-range guard: when a2 is not below v14 = a2 + a5*a4 the source range is empty, so skip the pass and return 0.

Outer loop over the a4 output rows while v6 stays below v14 = a2 + a5*a4; each iteration advances the destination pointer a1 by a6 bytes and the source position by 2*a5 bytes (two source rows consumed per output row).
Per-row guard: when the current source column v6 has already reached the row end v20 = a2 + 4*a3, skip the row's pixel loop.

Inner pixel loop running ((v20 - v6 - 1) >> 3) + 1 times; each iteration advances the source window v8 by 8 bytes (2 dwords) and the destination cursor v18 by one dword, giving the 2:1 horizontal downsample.
Gather the 2x2 source neighborhood around the current dword v8: left pixel *(v8 - 1), current pixel *v8, below pixel *(v8 + a5) (v19), and below-left pixel *(v8 + a5 - 4) (v17).

Channel-separated 4-tap average: mask and sum each of the 0xFF00FF byte pairs of the four pixels, add rounding 131074, shift right by 2; fold the shifted high-byte sums (masked 0x3FC03FC0 and 0xFFC03FC0, base 0x00800080, subtract 8388480) so the middle byte is recovered without cross-byte carry.
Write the averaged dword to the destination at the incrementing cursor v18.
